splashes.name: worm
splashes.title: WORM
splashes.prompt: A giant segmented pink earthworm hero bursting up through rich dark soil under a huge golden sun, treasure coins and jewels raining from its tunnel, a menacing giant crow diving from stormy sky. Whimsical but epic underground adventure. Dirt clumps and roots flying. Retro computer game energy.

splashes.name: alien-from-mars
splashes.title: THE ALIEN FROM MARS
splashes.prompt: A chrome flying saucer beaming up a startled cow over a twilight countryside, mutated two-headed fire-breathing steak monster rampaging below, tanks and jets scrambling, purple Martian skies, chaos and comedy mixed with sci-fi pulp cover intensity.

splashes.name: maze-explorer
splashes.title: MAZE EXPLORER
splashes.prompt: First-person dungeon horror box art: a terrified adventurer's hands gripping a glowing blaster, facing a gigantic multi-eyed floating BEHOLDER demon in a torchlit stone labyrinth. Blood-red gems, gothic arches, green eye-beams, pure Wolfenstein / Doom era intensity with fantasy monsters.

splashes.name: pinball
splashes.title: PINBALL
splashes.prompt: A dazzling chrome pinball machine erupting with light and sparks, silver ball mid-flight hitting a bumper, neon score digits exploding, carnival colors, 1980s arcade cabinet energy, metal and glass reflections painted in classic game-box style.

splashes.name: indigokart2
splashes.title: INDIGO KART
splashes.prompt: Cute cartoon racers in colorful go-karts drifting around a sunset tropical island track, neon city and rainbow road in the sky behind them, motion blur speed lines, Mario Kart era box art energy but original characters, pink horse mascot waving a checkered flag.

splashes.name: star-bean
splashes.title: STAR BEAN
splashes.prompt: A heroic fluffy white mohawked dog in a sleek starfighter blasting through neon space, giant mechanical boss ship ahead, lasers and explosions, Star Fox / After Burner box art drama, cosmic pink and teal colors, Space Bean defender of the galaxy.

splashes.name: bean-quiz
splashes.title: BEAN QUIZ
splashes.prompt: A glittery kids game-show stage with a tiny white mohawked dog host in a sparkly jacket and a smug orange tabby cat sidekick with a microphone, confetti cannons, giant glowing question marks, 80s Saturday morning cartoon meets game show box art.

splashes.name: coin-collector
splashes.title: COIN COLLECTOR
splashes.prompt: A brave little blue-clad platformer hero leaping between floating islands collecting giant gold coins, green hills and blue sky, classic 8-bit adventure box painting style like Super Mario Bros cover energy but original art.

splashes.name: platform-runner
splashes.title: PLATFORM RUNNER
splashes.prompt: A speedy hero sprinting across collapsing platforms, dodging spikes and cartoon enemies, night city rooftops, dynamic diagonal action composition, classic NES action platformer box art intensity.

splashes.name: chickencraft
splashes.title: CHICKENCRAFT
splashes.prompt: A brave chicken miner in a blocky voxel world swinging a pickaxe, diamonds and dirt cubes flying, Minecraft-era sandbox adventure box art but with a heroic chicken protagonist under a blocky sunset.

splashes.name: bean-simulator
splashes.title: BEAN SIMULATOR
splashes.prompt: A tiny fluffy white dog with a mohawk exploring a cozy oversized living room from dog's-eye view, golden afternoon light through curtains, toys and treats, warm whimsical first-person adventure box art.

splashes.name: vibekart
splashes.title: VIBEKART
splashes.prompt: Surreal neon dream-race: go-karts on a procedurally melting rainbow highway through vaporwave clouds, synthwave sunset, chrome rims and glowing trails, 80s futurism box art.

splashes.name: indigokart
splashes.title: INDIGO KART CLASSIC
splashes.prompt: Charming miniature 3D kart racer box art, small colorful karts racing a simple loop track, cheerful sky, classic early 3D console racing game cover painting.
